offer.text: I haven't found my trade yet, but I do get hungry. Could you spare me 6 bread?

accept.text: Truly? That's kinder than most folk bother to be.

decline.text: No matter. I'm used to going without.

in_progress.text: Did you bring anything to eat?

ready.text: Six whole loaves — I haven't seen so much bread in weeks!

complete.text: I won't forget this. One day I'll repay you, I swear it.
